messages:
Jordan: Quick sweep — we need firm owners + due dates for INC-628 postmortem closure tasks before EOD Fri. I'll paste the current open items below.

Jordan: ```1) Postmortem writeup (add timeline + mitigations) — owner: ___ — due: ___
2) Canary rollback doc + runbook updates — owner: ___ — due: ___
3) Alerting & runbook gaps (pager paths + escalation) — owner: ___ — due: ___
4) DB config rollback test (automated) — owner: ___ — due: ___
5) Metrics validation for impact window (data queries) — owner: ___ — due: ___
6) Playbook: gradual failover steps (ops checklist) — owner: ___ — due: ___```

Maria: I can take item 3 (alerting/runbooks). ETA Tue 2026-03-24. @Kevin can you pick up item 2?

Kevin: Taking item 2. ETA Thu 2026-03-19. Will open a docs PR and tag reviewers.

Ashley: I'll own item 1 (writeup) but need metrics to validate the timeline. @Sam can you confirm you can produce the queries?

Sam: Yep — I can run those queries and drop results in the incident doc by Wed 2026-03-18. :thumbsup:

Jordan: Thanks — assigning as called out. Who can take item 4 (DB rollback test)? this one is blocking the rollback playbook merge.

Ryan: I can pick up item 4. ETA Fri 2026-03-20 EOD. Will add test scripts under infra/tests/rollback.

ops-bot: Reminder: if any owner wants the oncall rotation to run the test, add `oncall_responsible: true` in the incident metadata.

Maria: Noted. I'll add `oncall_responsible: false` for runbook updates and will link PRs.

Ashley: I'll coordinate with data-platform for the metrics step and will draft the writeup by Thu morning.

data-platform: Confirmed — we'll hand off the validated query results to @Ashley by Wed.

Jordan: Summary — owners set: 1@Ashley (Thu AM), 2@Kevin (3/19), 3@Maria (3/24), 4@Ryan (3/20), 5@Sam (3/18), 6@Jordan (I'll draft the ops checklist by Tue). If any ETA slips, update the incident doc or ping here. I'll compile the final action table and attach to the postmortem. :eyes:

Maria: Adding quick checklist and links now: https://redwood.link/inc628-actions

Kevin: Will ping reviewers once PR is up.

Ryan: I'll post test logs to the incident thread when done.

Jordan: Thanks everyone — closing the sweep. If anything changes, update the doc and call it out in this thread so SRE can re-prioritize.
